children: LatentView Analytics, the Chennai-based AI-driven analytics, data engineering and consulting firm, reported a 6 per cent growth in consolidated net profit for the quarter ended September 2026 at ₹48.4 crore as against ₹45.7 crore in the corresponding quarter last year.
Revenue was up 14 per cent at ₹294 crore compared to ₹257 crore a year ago.

“We are pleased to be back on the growth trajectory this quarter, with revenue increasing 2 per cent sequentially in dollar terms. Growth was broad-based, led by our Automotive business, alongside steady gains in Financial Services and CPG & Retail. AI continues to scale across our business, driving efficiency and productivity as we leverage top-tier tech and ecosystem partnerships to accelerate client adoption of our AI solutions,” Sonal Ramrakhiani, Chief Executive Officer, LatentView, said.
Ramrakhiani added that the company anticipates some short-term impact from macroeconomic sentiment and headwinds in the technology sector.
As for revenue mix from specific industry verticals, technology stood at 55 per cent, financial services at 21 per cent Retail & CPG at 15 per cent and Industrial & others at 9 per cent.
North America contributed 89 per cent of the revenue while Europe recorded 2 per cent and the rest of the world with 9 per cent.
LatentView reported a headcount of 1,779 employees as of Q2 FY27 with the LTM attrition rate was at 25 per cent.

title: LatentView Analytics Q2 results: PAT rises 6% to ₹48 crore
